newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Gruma started as underperform.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Gruma started as underperform.

text.p: -- Santander Investments initiated coverage of Mexican foodmaker Gruma SA with an underperform rating.
-- Analyst Rolando Calderon said Gruma's stock looks fairly priced after having risen by more than 127 percent over the past year.

-- Calderon said the company's stock is trading at a high premium to the local market and food sector, however. He added that much of its profits in 1995-96 will come from noncash monetary correction gains.

-- He also said U.S. food giant Archer Daniels Midland Co paid a surprisingly low price for its recent 22 percent stake in Gruma, the leading producer of corn flour and corn flour products in North America.
-- Gruma was trading 10 centavos lower at 50.10 pesos in quiet midday trade on the Mexican bourse.
